text:
mira: Ping, escalation from Acme - their integration started returning 400 SchemaValidation errors after their tool rename.

acme-admin: We renamed price_lookup -> price.lookup yesterday via Console. Some production calls that still use price_lookup now get back: {\"error\":\"SchemaValidationError\", \"message\": \"unexpected field 'query'\", \"code\":400}. We didn't change the client.

mira: Can you paste the failing request/response?

acme-admin: Sure: 

```
POST /v1/toolcall HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-XXXXX
Content-Type: application/json

{\"tool\":\"price_lookup\",\"args\":{\"query\":\"sku:1234\"}}
```

Response: 

```json
{
  "error": "SchemaValidationError",
  "message": "unexpected field 'query' for tool price_lookup",
  "code": 400
}
```

tom: Hmm. If the canonical is price.lookup we should accept the old alias while it is in tombstone/grace period. Can we check registry event history for that tenant?

registry-bot: event 2024-11-03T08:12:04Z - rename price_lookup -> price.lookup (actor: acme-admin). Old alias marked tombstoned, grace_window=14d.

eli: I inspected registry for tenant acme-corp: canonical=price.lookup, aliases include price_lookup but status shows tombstoned. Our alias-resolution path is supposed to return tombstoned metadata until expiry, but I see the cache returned 404 for that alias during a resync window.

mira: Customer reports this is coming from an older SDK that does schema discovery at call-time then invokes. If schema fetch returns nothing for price_lookup, the client falls back to an older compatibility schema that doesn't accept {\"query\"}, hence the validation error.

eli: Repro steps I used locally: 
1) apply rename event
2) flush registry cache (simulates sync)
3) hit /v1/toolcall with tool=price_lookup

Repro curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-XXXXX\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"tool":"price_lookup","args":{"query":"sku:1234"}}'
```

eli: When cache misses and alias-service returns 404 for tombstoned alias, our server falls back to legacy-schema-resolver which expects args {\"sku\":...} and rejects {\"query\"}. I can reproduce reliably when the alias metadata is missing from cache.

mira: Is that intended? Docs say tombstoned aliases are honored for grace window so clients have time to migrate.

tom: Found it - alias-service v2 was rolled out with a config drift: tombstone_grace_seconds set to 0 for some tenants due to a bad default. Ops rolled v2 at 2024-11-03T07:58:12Z. 

ops-bot: deploy alias-service v2 -> prod-1 at 2024-11-03T07:58:12Z

mira: Customer impact: elevated 4xxs, app errors, and billing confusion (customer saw billed requests that failed client-side parsing). They disputed a few charges.

eli: Short-term mitigations: 1) Ask customer to call by tool UUID or update to canonical name price.lookup; 2) we can re-enable alias grace for their tenant immediately via feature flag.

mira: I told the customer: "Workaround: use the tool UUID or price.lookup. We've re-enabled alias-grace for your tenant; should propagate in <5m. We'll follow up with a permanent fix." :thumbsup:

acme-admin: Confirming - UUID call succeeded, errors dropped to zero. Can you confirm there was no token leak?

mira: No token exposure - this was name resolution + schema mismatch only.

tom: Long-term fixes: rollback the bad TTL default, add an automated regression test that flushes registry cache and ensures tombstoned aliases still resolve during grace window, and add alerting for spikes in SchemaValidation errors correlated with recent rename events.

eli: I'm drafting a PR to change alias-service to return tombstoned metadata (soft-404) instead of a hard 404 during the grace window; includes unit & e2e test. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/registry/pulls/4567

ops-bot: feature-flag alias-grace restored for tenant acme-corp (toggle on)

mira: Customer reports fixes are working on their end. I'll leave this open until PR merges and we'll run an audit across other tenants for similar misconfig.

acme-admin: Thanks for fast response, UUID works. Please keep me posted.

mira: Adding notes for postmortem: cause=alias-service v2 config drift set grace_window=0, symptom=SchemaValidation 400s for old-alias calls, detection=customer report + 4xx spike, mitigations=re-enable alias-grace + UUID workaround, fix=PR to treat tombstones as soft-404 + TTL rollback, followups=audit & regression test.

tom: Also adding a console banner for recently renamed tools to warn customers using older SDKs.

mira: Will update thread when PR merges and when audit completes.
